name: B10-0031/2024 (S&D) – Continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
title: Resolution on continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on EU countries to keep backing Ukraine with money, weapons and political support against Russia's war. It asks them to send ammunition and air defence systems faster, allow Western weapons to hit military targets inside Russia, and pressure Hungary to stop blocking payments. It wants long-term money for Ukraine's recovery beyond 2027, more sanctions on Russia, and a way to use frozen Russian assets to pay for the damage. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament is asking EU governments to act.
- **Who it affects:** EU member states, Ukraine, Russia, and Hungary's blockade.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions and Ukraine; governments decide whether to act.
